summary: Narrowed the path-scoped frontmatter of plan-drafter.md and independent-auditor.md to eliminate the docs/** rule scope bleed flagged in docs/REAUDIT_VERDICT.md, producing zero overlapping path scopes across all five rule files.

defect.description: plan-drafter.md and independent-auditor.md both declared paths: docs/**, so both rules were injected simultaneously whenever an agent touched any file under docs/.

independent-auditor.md.body_change: Reworded the two body lines that referenced docs/** and docs/SDLC_PLAN.md so the prose matches the narrowed scope.

resolution.coordinator_decision: Original instruction listed .orchestration/contracts/*.json inside independent-auditor.md, which would have created a new overlap with auditor.md. Consulted the coordinator via `orca orchestration ask`; it selected option B (drop contracts) so auditor.md retains sole ownership of .orchestration/contracts/*.json and overlap is zero.

empirical_proof.description: Instruction budget OK; total 66 of 150 (independent-auditor.md 9/30, plan-drafter.md 5/30).
Instruction-budget check plus the node --test suite: 12 pass, 0 fail.
Static harness validation (flow.config.json, .yukl-intent.yml, rule frontmatter, contract naming, single-VCS invariant, GitHub standards) passes.
Independent pairwise frontmatter path-scope check across all rule files: PAIR_OVERLAPS=[], no docs/** glob remains. Zero scope bleed.
